{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies CMakeLists.txt, cmake/bitcoin-build-config.h.in, and cmake/module/InstallBinaryComponent.cmake to propagate install path variables to the binary.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes installed binary execution on Linux distributions like Arch Linux that override CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBEXECDIR. Supported-platform execution failures block users on those platforms from running the installed wrapper command."
    },
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes src/bitcoin.cpp, the multiprocess wrapper executable that launches bitcoin-node and related internal binaries.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.55,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Ensures the bitcoin wrapper can locate and spawn internal executables like bitcoin-node when installed on distributions with non-standard libexec layouts. Without this fix, invocations fail immediately with execvp 'No such file or directory'."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Directly updates the bitcoin wrapper command-line utility in src/bitcoin.cpp.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Resolves a hardcoded path lookup bug in the bitcoin wrapper tool on systems installing libexec binaries to non-default locations. The fix restores tool functionality on affected systems but is reasonably deferrable."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 0,
    "bug_severity": 2,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 0
  }
}
